snippet.title: Aarambh - The Journey Begins | Unacademy Centre Foundation Day | June 15, 2023
snippet.description:
One year of igniting dreams. 
One year of embracing grit and determination. 
One year of preparing to crack it.

This milestone is dedicated to those who have conquered their goals and to those who are relentlessly striving to achieve theirs.

snippet.title: Unacademy Connect: Defence as an aspiring Career| Lt Gen SL Narasimhan, PVSM, AVSM*, VSM, PhD (Retd)
snippet.description:
Unacademy Connect is a series of ‘Career Guidance’ sessions where students come together from across all platforms, backgrounds and geographies to understand emerging career opportunities and to hear from experienced industry practitioners, mentors and seasoned professionals from a variety of sectors. The aim of this series is to help young learners to find their career calling and take well-informed career decisions.
This is an extremely insightful session on how Defence can be an aspiring career where Lt Gen SL Narasimhan, PVSM, AVSM*, VSM, PhD (Retd), shares his experiences and stories which will motivate and inspire many to join one of India’s most prestigious professions.

snippet.title: Making of Lesson No. 7
snippet.description:
Behind the 85 seconds narrative of Lesson No. 7, that inspired thousands of Learners to break barriers, lies a journey that involved: 

8 months of total project duration
7 days of set and stunt prep
5 days of shoot 
200+ crew members on live action shoot
40+ artists for post production across 4 countries
3 months of VFX

Here’s a glimpse of what went on behind the screens of delivering a life lesson from Dhoni’s life for our Learners and how the movie came to life, frame by frame. 

#DhoniUnacademyFilm #LessonNo7 #MakingOfDhoniFilm

snippet.title: Mistakes - The Greatest Teacher
snippet.description:
Life or cricket, it is impossible to complete an innings without making mistakes. But, before you say ‘Oh No’ to the mistakes, don’t forget to take a step back and embrace the learnings! This IPL season, let’s cheer our mistakes as well as those of our favourite teams. Because mistakes are beautiful, and they make us better and stronger!

Forget the mistakes, remember the lessons. 

Credits:
1. Music: Vinayak Manohar
2. Oh No: Tiara Arpit
3. Singing: Jaaved Jaaferi
4. Original ‘Remember (Walking In The Sand)’ written and composed by George Morton

#MistakesTheGreatestTeacher #IPLUnacademyFilm

snippet.title: Unacademy | The Greatest Lesson
snippet.description:
The sound of success is strung with notes. 
Notes of despair. 
Of grit and rigour. 
Of the pit of fire. 
Fueled by dreams and passion. 
Of the journey that shakes confidence. 
Of the journey that shapes character. 
The sound of success is loud. 
But the silence of hard work and perseverance speaks louder. 
So, rekindle the dreams, 
Rebuild the path.
For those who crack it, seldom give up. 
They keep going amidst all odds, 
For passion is undefeatable.

#TheGreatestLesson feat. Sachin Tendulkar 
#SachinUnacademyFilm
